dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual linear-to-concave narrowing from the mid-section toward the posterior, terminating in a sharp convergence.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Generally smooth lateral margins with minor asymmetrical deviations where the skin meets turbulent water in the mid-anterior region.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-intensity normalized pixel values across the visible dorsal plane.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A series of approximately five dark, circular point-contrast marks/pits aligned along the posterior dorsal midline.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Distinct topological depressions causing shadow-casting along the central dorsal axis, aligned with a prominent longitudinal ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A linear sequence of punctate pockmarks or scars located centrally on the dorsal ridge.
other_distinctive_markers: Sharply defined dorsal ridge extending along the posterior third of the visible dorsal surface.
